title: Warm Smoky Ethiopian Puff Pastry Fir Fir
description: A smoky, shaggy, kid-friendly Ethiopian dish featuring puff pastry, double-fry-KFC style, lacto-vegetarian-friendly, in a fir-fir form, cooked in a robata-grill vessel.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the puff pastry into 1-inch wide strips.
Heat 1 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.

Double-fry the puff pastry strips, first frying at 325 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 minutes, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and frying for an additional 2-3 minutes, until golden brown.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the berbere spice, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the crumbled feta cheese to the pan and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked puff pastry strips to the pan and stir to combine with the cheese and spice mixture.
Transfer the mixture to the robata-grill and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through and slightly charred.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
